examples.en: This bag is light.
I weighed my luggage at the airport.
How much does the parcel weigh?
The suitcase weighs 20 kilos.

examples.en: How do I weigh it? — Put it up here.

explain_en: '무게' goes with '나가다': 이 가방은 무게가 많이 나가요 (This bag is heavy). A person's body weight is '몸무게'. In Korea, weight is given in kg (킬로).

examples.en: These snacks are popular.
This singer is popular abroad too.
This drama is popular in Korea these days.
What's the popular menu item? — It's the bulgogi set meal.

examples.ko: 이 상품은 인기가 없어요. 사람들이 안 사요.
examples.en: This product isn't popular. People don't buy it.

explain: ‘인기’ 뒤에 ‘있다/많다’를 붙여요: 인기가 있어요, 인기가 많아요. 반대는 ‘인기가 없어요’예요.

phrases.example: 그 가수는 요즘 인기가 하늘을 찔러요.
phrases.nuance_en: an exaggeration meaning someone is extremely popular

explain_en: Put 있다 or 많다 after 인기: 인기가 있어요, 인기가 많아요. The opposite is 인기가 없어요.

examples.en: This design is in style.
This song is really popular right now.
That outfit is already out of fashion.
Keeping up with trends is hard.
Last year this color was a big trend.

explain: ‘유행’은 옷이나 노래뿐 아니라 퍼지는 병에도 써요: 독감이 유행이에요.

phrases.example: 이 디자인은 유행을 안 타서 오래 입을 수 있어요.
phrases.en: to be subject to trends; to go in and out of style
phrases.nuance_ko: ‘유행을 안 타다’는 언제 입어도 괜찮다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: here 유행을 안 타다 means a style that looks fine at any time
phrases.en_equiv: to be subject to trends; to go in and out of style

explain_en: 유행 is used not only for clothes and songs but also for illnesses that spread: 독감이 유행이에요 (the flu is going around).

examples.en: This juice is free.
Coffee refills are free today.
At this shop, cake is free on your birthday.

examples.ko: 공짜 표가 두 장 있어요. 같이 갈까요?
examples.en: I have two free tickets. Shall we go together?

examples.ko: 카페에 공짜 와이파이가 있어요. 저는 거기서 일해요.
examples.en: The café has free Wi-Fi. I work there.

explain: 공짜는 친구와 편하게 말할 때 많이 써요. 가게 안내문이나 공식 글에서는 보통 “무료”라고 써요.

dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

explain_en: 공짜 is the everyday word, used a lot in relaxed talk. On shop signs and official notices you usually see 무료 instead.

examples.en: Do you have the receipt? Then an exchange is easy.
It's too small. Can I exchange it?

examples.ko: 교환은 일주일 안에 할 수 있어요.
examples.en: You can exchange it within a week.
Please exchange it for a different color.

examples.ko: 교환이에요, 환불이에요? — 사이즈가 너무 커요. 바꾸고 싶어요.
examples.en: Is it an exchange or a refund? — It's too big. I want to swap it.

explain: 가게에서 “교환”은 다른 물건으로 바꾸는 거예요. 돈을 돌려받는 건 “환불”이에요.

explain_en: In a shop, 교환 means swapping for another item. Getting your money back is 환불.

examples.en: Gift wrapping is free.
It's a present for a friend. Gift wrapping, please.
Will you eat here? — No, it's to go.
The packaging was too flimsy. The cup broke.

examples.ko: 이 빵집은 포장이 예쁘고 빵도 맛있어요.
examples.en: This bakery's wrapping is pretty and the bread is tasty too.

explain: 식당에서 음식을 가져갈 때는 “포장해 주세요”라고 해요. 카페에서는 “테이크아웃”이라는 말도 많이 써요.

explain_en: At a restaurant, say 포장해 주세요 when you want food to go. At cafés you will also hear the word 테이크아웃 a lot.

examples.en: The delivery comes on Monday.
I ordered a pizza delivery for lunch.
The delivery was late. The food went cold.

examples.ko: 이 식당은 배달도 해요? — 네, 저녁 아홉 시까지 해요.
examples.en: Does this restaurant deliver too? — Yes, until nine in the evening.

examples.ko: 배달원이 문 앞에 음식을 놓고 갔어요.
examples.en: The delivery person left the food at my door.

explain: 음식은 보통 “배달(을) 시키다”라고 말해요. “배달하다”는 가게 사람이 가져다주는 거예요.

국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

explain_en: To order food for delivery, say 배달(을) 시키다. 배달하다 is what the shop does: they bring it to you.

examples.en: There was a sale ad in front of the mart.
That actor is in a TV commercial.

examples.ko: 유튜브 광고가 너무 길었어요. 그냥 건너뛰었어요.
examples.en: The YouTube ad was so long. I just skipped it.
I keep getting advertising texts on my phone.

examples.ko: 새 가게는 인터넷에 광고를 많이 해요.
examples.en: The new shop advertises a lot online.

explain: 회사는 광고를 “하다”, TV나 유튜브에서는 광고가 “나오다”라고 해요. 두 동사를 같이 기억하세요.

dict_examples.ko: 아이가 달리기에서 우승을 했다고 동네방네 광고를 하고 다녔다.
dict_examples.en: He went around the neighborhood announcing that his child had won the race.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

explain_en: A company 광고를 하다 (runs ads), and on TV or YouTube 광고가 나오다 (ads come on). Remember both verbs.

examples.en: This juice sells well.

examples.ko: 그 공연 표가 벌써 다 팔렸어요.
examples.en: Tickets for that show are already sold out.

examples.ko: 이 책은 지난달에 십만 권이나 팔렸어요.
examples.en: This book sold 100,000 copies last month alone.

examples.ko: 인기가 많아요. 빵이 아침에 다 팔려요.
examples.en: It's very popular. The bread sells out in the morning.

examples.ko: 이 가방은 요즘 잘 안 팔려요.
examples.en: This bag hasn't been selling well lately.

explain: “팔다”는 사람이 주어고, “팔리다”는 물건이 주어예요. 차를 팔아요 → 차가 팔려요.

phrases.example: 새 휴대폰이 날개 돋친 듯이 팔려요.
phrases.nuance_ko: 날개가 생긴 것처럼 아주 빨리 팔린다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: used when something sells very fast, as if it had grown wings
used when something sells quickly and in large quantities

dict_examples.ko: 갑자기 더워진 날씨에 선풍기가 많이 팔리고 있다.
dict_examples.en: Fans are selling a lot in the suddenly hot weather.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

explain_en: With 팔다 the subject is a person; with 팔리다 the subject is the thing. 차를 팔아요 (I sell the car) → 차가 팔려요 (the car sells).

dis.h: be sold; everyday spoken, items selling well

p.n: Same meaning; 판매되다 sounds more formal, like a store or report.

en: to pull out; to pick; to select

examples.en: On Friday, we'll draw ten customers.

examples.ko: 회사에서 새 직원을 두 명 뽑았어요.
examples.en: The company hired two new employees.
I took a number ticket at the bank and waited.
I took some cash out of the ATM.

examples.ko: 주말에 할머니 집 마당에서 풀을 뽑았어요.
examples.en: On the weekend I pulled weeds in grandma's yard.

explain: 회사가 사람을 뽑으면 그 사람은 “뽑혔어요”라고 해요. 뽑다는 “고르다”와 “쑥 빼내다” 두 뜻이 있어요.

phrases.nuance_en: used when you get back at least as much value as you paid

dict_examples.ko: 예선을 거친 네 명 중에서 대표를 뽑기로 했다.
dict_examples.en: They decided to choose a representative from among the four who passed the preliminaries.

dict_examples.en: The kids in the class wanted to elect a child with good friendships as class president.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

dict_examples.en: I went to the dentist and had a wisdom tooth pulled.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

explain_en: If a company 뽑다 someone, that person says 뽑혔어요 (I was chosen). 뽑다 has two main senses: choose, and pull out.
